body:
[Erowid Note: 
Driving while intoxicated, tripping, or extremely sleep deprived is dangerous and irresponsible because it endangers other people.
Don't do it!
]
(4:03am): While driving home, the mdma or mde kicks in.  Strengthened xtc feel. Possibly increased with the foxy. Driving is really fun but I seem to be on auto-pilot and able to drive fine. I ask those driving with me how I'm doing and they reply with 'you're driving normal'.
(4:28am): Thirsty! Slightly dehydrated.
(5:00am): Smoked some weed. Very relaxed. The pot tastes a little better than usual. I am able to take big hits.. its impressive how big my clouds are getting. Deep breaths are good.
(??6:00): Open-eye Visuals. Ceiling is spiraling and waving. Colors are all over the place. Stuck talking and learning about myself in the mirror for awhile. My pupils are huge hardly any iris. Vines on the kitchen wallpaper are growing and the grapes on the wallpaper tastes like grapes. I feel as though I'm in the 'matrix' and I can control how I want things to move. I managed to flex in the mirror with the shirt off and made my self look insanely strong/hot :)
(6:00am - 11:00pm ): Still 'foxyflippin'.. Extreme empathy, locked jaw, constantly giggling, speedy, [as typed in file: see below] 'the loss of the ability to be sad'. My mind seemed to dismiss things that made me thing of anything sad. (i.e. friend leaves, I begin to get sad. Seconds later I'm back in bliss and doing something else.) Watched Alice in Wonderland...wow. :D
(12:23pm) File was created on my computer with thoughts, and revelations I was having during 'foxyflippin'.
(12:25am) File was last saved with my last thoughts and my goodnight.
It appeared as though every time I smoked, visuals intensified.
